name: mape_pct
meaning: Average percent off for that group. Always positive. This is MAPE. 10 means the jobs in the group were 10% off on average.

name: median_abs_pct_err
meaning: Percent off of the middle job. Half the jobs are closer than this, half are worse. One disaster moves MAPE a lot and barely moves this.

name: mean_abs_err_ms
meaning: Average miss in milliseconds. A 1000 ms miss counts the same on a short job and a long job. MAPE would call the short job much worse.

name: median_abs_err_ms
meaning: Miss in milliseconds of the middle job. Not a percent.

name: mean_signed_pct_err
meaning: Average percent with a sign. Positive means the guesses were too high. Too-high and too-low cancel, so this can look small when MAPE is large.

name: median_signed_pct_err
meaning: Signed percent of the middle job. Positive means that guess was too high.

name: abs_err
meaning: One job, milliseconds off. The average of this column is mean_abs_err_ms.

name: abs_pct_err
meaning: One job, percent off, always positive. The average of this column is mape_pct.

name: signed_pct_err
meaning: One job, percent with a sign. Positive means this guess was too high. MAPE uses the absolute value so the sign is dropped.

name: avg_pct_err_same_S / _N / _M / _regime
meaning: Written on every per-line row. MAPE of the jobs that share that S, or that N, or that M, or that saturated/unsaturated label.

name: avg_ms_err_same_S / _N / _M / _regime
meaning: Written on every per-line row. Average millisecond miss of the jobs that share that knob. Not a percent.
